newsitem.title: USA: Champion Enterprises falls on Q1 EPS view.
newsitem.headline: Champion Enterprises falls on Q1 EPS view.

text.p: Shares of Champion Enterprises Inc fell 3-5/8 to 14-1/2 Monday after the company announced its first-quarter earnings per share would be below analysts' consensus estimates of $0.32.
Champion, whose first-quarter estimate of $0.28 a share approximates year-ago results, also said fiscal 1997 earnings per share will land in the $1.62 to $1.67 range.

The company, which produces manufactured homes and medium-duty buses, said its sales and income were lower after a restructuring of its product line during the quarter. Champion also said it incurred startup expenses at three plants.
